description: One law firm: its attorneys, the firms it most often faces, the medical experts named for its side, its motion practice, and how its cases ended. A firm's case counts (cases, plaintiffCases, defenseCases) cover every case it appeared in. Its other figures (casesByYear, opposing firms, experts, motion practice, outcomes), the stats plaintiff_firm and defense_firm dimensions and the firm_juris_number filter cover only the cases where it is a side's lead firm, so one firm's case total can differ slightly from place to place.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

name: get_firm

attorneys.description: Attorneys who have filed with this firm.

name.description: Attorney name; null when the registry has none.

cases.description: Every case the firm appeared in, as lead firm or not. The firm's other figures count only the cases it leads a side in, so their totals can be a little lower.

casesByYear.description: Cases the firm leads a side in, by the year they were filed.

defenseCases.description: Of cases, those where the firm appeared for the defense, as lead firm or not.

districts.description: Judicial districts the firm appeared in.

expertsDisclosed.description: Medical providers named for this side in its cases, most frequent first.

cases.description: Of these cases, those naming the provider.

jurisNumber.description: Firm juris number, for get_firm and the firm filters.

kind.description: individual: a person's name rather than a firm's, such as a solo practitioner.

motionPractice.description: This side's motions in these cases and how often they were granted.

decided.description: Of those, rulings that decided the motion: granted, denied or granted in part.

grantRate.description: granted / decided; null when none were decided.

opposingFirms.description: Lead firms on the other side, most frequent first.

name.description: Firm name; null when the firm is not in the dataset.

acceptedOffer.description: Accepted offers of compromise in cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo; most such cases close by withdrawal, which the court removes.

medianCents.description: Median amount in cents; null when n is 0.

p25Cents.description: Nearest-rank 25th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

p75Cents.description: Nearest-rank 75th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

closedFrom.description: First disposition date counted, inclusive. Outcome counts here cover only cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo, not all time.

closedTo.description: Last disposition date counted, inclusive: the dataset as-of date.

dispositions.description: Cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo, counted by disposition category. Counts only cases closed in the 330 days ending at the as-of date (closedFrom to closedTo): the court removes withdrawn cases about a year after withdrawal, so only the last ~11 months of closures are complete. A district last fetched before the as-of date contributes closures only up to its fetch date, a slightly shorter window; the closures it does contribute are still complete.

netVerdict.description: Every net jury verdict on record, not limited to closedFrom to closedTo: verdicts are not removed from the court website.

medianCents.description: Median amount in cents; null when n is 0.

p25Cents.description: Nearest-rank 25th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

p75Cents.description: Nearest-rank 75th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

plaintiffCases.description: Of cases, those where the firm appeared for the plaintiff, as lead firm or not.

contactUrl.description: Contact form for asking about more access.

limitReached.description: Present only past the daily profile limit.

resetsAt.description: When the limit resets: the next UTC midnight, ISO 8601.

title: Law firm profile
